content.comment_body: Hello. I'm using [article_no]. I have an SD card containing a program that I want to load onto the controller, but I keep encountering an error. The program opens fine in [product_name] software, but I can't write it to the controller. When I try to upload the program directly from the SD card using the controller, it restarts and appears empty. What should I do?
It seems likely that the SD card program copy function is causing the issue. Please refer to the attached [document] for more information.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces issues when transferring a program from an SD card to a [product_name] controller. Although the program opens in the relevant software, attempts to load it onto the hardware lead to errors, and uploading directly causes the controller to restart without program data. Another user suggests this may be caused by an activated program copy function for SD cards, which disrupts normal operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward and error-free process for loading programs from SD cards to controllers, ensuring no configuration loss.
